tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Retrieve product information by product ID. Returns name, category, price, stock, and brand for a single product.

input_schema.description:
Input model for the ``get_product`` tool.

Fields
------
product_id:
    Product identifier.  Must match ``^P[0-9]+$`` — strictly ASCII.
    Examples: P1001, P1002, P9999.

product_id.description: Product identifier. Format: P followed by ASCII digits. Example: P1001
product_id.title: Product Id

input_schema.title: ProductInput

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Retrieve user information by user ID. Returns name, city, and membership tier for a single user.

input_schema.description:
Input model for the ``get_user`` tool.

Fields
------
user_id:
    User identifier.  Must match ``^U[0-9]+$`` — strictly ASCII.
    Examples: U1001, U1002.

user_id.description: User identifier. Format: U followed by ASCII digits. Example: U1001
user_id.title: User Id

input_schema.title: UserInput

tools.name: get_user_orders
tools.description: Retrieve orders for a user by user ID. Returns a paginated list of orders with truncation flag if more exist.

input_schema.description:
Input model for the ``get_user_orders`` tool.

Fields
------
user_id:
    User identifier.  Must match ``^U[0-9]+$``.
limit:
    Maximum number of orders to return.  Capped server-side at
    ``ORDERS_ROW_LIMIT_MAX`` (default 100).  The LLM cannot override this.

user_id.description: User identifier. Format: U followed by ASCII digits. Example: U1001
user_id.title: User Id

limit.description: Maximum orders to return (1–100). Server enforces this even if LLM requests more.
limit.title: Limit

input_schema.title: UserOrdersInput
